title: A part created with tracking left on still shows its available quantity
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part. Fill Description, Part Number, Category and Cost. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods ON.
  2. Set the default bin Quantity to 5 and click Save.
  3. Search the new part number.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • The dialog closes with no error.

Step 3:

  • Total Qty shows the 5 available chip, as before this release (no Not Tracked text).
  • Min and Max show the typed values.
